row.body: The route key is tied to a note asking the driver to slow down near the test plots. The arrival box is checked before the fuel stop.
row.title: Slow road instruction

sidecar.gloss: A driver is warned near a work area while the route record skips ahead.
sidecar.rival_reading: An emergency detour could explain both the slow route and early arrival entry; the note does not identify the plots.

row.body: the toilet roll and water bottle are packed with treated seed. every kernel has the same cracked green coating.
row.title: field residue on the toilet roll

sidecar.gloss: A rare everyday object carries residue tied to field work before restriction.
sidecar.rival_reading: Emergency workers crossing treated land could have picked up the same residue; the objects do not prove the farm program began the emergency.
